page_title: HOF 1-4 LEV | Hoffenheim v Bayer Leverkusen 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card.
90+6' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' A terrific attempt by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
90+6' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Bayer Leverkusen fail to score from a corner as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
90+3' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
90+2' The foul by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Schlager.
90+1' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 5:9 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
87' Substitution. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marius Bulter walks off.
87' Here comes a substitution. Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Andrej Kramaric.
86' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Piero Hincapie.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) coming on for Victor Boniface.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
85' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Hoffenheim earn a corner.
83' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

82' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Lukas Hradecky allowed him to make a comfortable save. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Here comes a substitution. Martin Terrier is given a rest as he is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Robert Andrich will be replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) replaces Tim Drexler.

76' 1 - 4 An amazing individual effort from Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 1:4. Oliver Baumann was helpless.
75' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.
74' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
72' The attendance is 30000.
72' 1 - 3 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Oliver Baumann.
71' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
71' It’s a PENALTY to Bayer Leverkusen after the VAR review!

70' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Schlager must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayer Leverkusen using VAR. This could be interesting!
70' PENALTY APPEAL by Bayer Leverkusen, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
68' The referee is firm and issues Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) a deserved yellow card.
67' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

67' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner.
65' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Schlager had a clear view and blows his whistle.
65' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:6.
63' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
61' Here is a change. Mergim Berisha is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
61' Substitution. Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) in, Alexander Prass out.
61' Referee Daniel Schlager has finally had enough of Pellegrino Matarazzo and brandishes a yellow card at him!

60' The game is interrupted. Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Hoffenheim have a free kick.

59' What a wonderful moment! Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the left post. His effort fails to surprise Oliver Baumann, who makes a nice save.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hoffenheim, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
57' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Nathan Tella.
56' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle after Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
53' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
53' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
51' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

50' Bayer Leverkusen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a long through ball, but Oliver Baumann deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+5' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+4' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+3' Nice individual effort by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take a corner kick.
44' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
39' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
39' A goal, which was scored by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim), was disallowed due to offside.
38' 1 - 2 Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Schlager ignores the protests.
33' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
32' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
30' 0 - 2 Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.

29' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

28' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a comfortable save! The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Wonderful movement by Bayer Leverkusen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
25' Hoffenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
23' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
21' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) scores after an assist by Victor Boniface that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
17' Referee Daniel Schlager points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) goes wild in celebration.
17' Attention! Referee Daniel Schlager straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
17' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
16' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle and it's Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
13' A great solo run by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Lukas Hradecky.
13' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
10' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.

8' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
7' Half-chance! Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) plays a pass into the box, but Lukas Hradecky reacts well to snuff out the attack.

5' A lofted cross from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a throw-in.
3' A rebound spins to Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
3' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.
2' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
1' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager will supervise the game today.
